description: The trace host's recordings do not replay where tick.cpp TraceInput delivered a modal dispatch through its `stuck` rule (a Blocking pump refused at a cursor count lower than the dispatch's, then taken at the second call with the same count): the recording gives the dispatch the cursor count of the call that took it, so the replay hands it to the first call. Measured over the 66 boot scenarios with frames (log/roadmap/S7/1_equiv_x64.tsv): 25 such deliveries in 7 scenarios (course_season_6y 6, ui_tour 7, ui_tour_v 7, cov_a_keys2 2, cov_a_career, cov_a_keys, cov_b_career 1 each); the replay of the recording still equals the live run in 4 of them and diverges (sg_run_boot -11) in cov_a_keys, ui_tour, ui_tour_v. The four deliveries logged (SG_LIVE_LOG, log/roadmap/S7/1_violations.log: cov_a_keys, cov_a_keys2 x2, cov_b_career) are each in an unpaced modal loop with no cursor read between its two pump calls; the other 21 were not logged. Gate (a) (live = sg_run_boot) is not affected; a live host never produces the pattern (must_deliver at those calls, U-1601).
path to resolution: Only a recording format change expresses it (a pump-call index per dispatch, e.g. in a meta key the replay reads), or the port's cursor-less loops read the cursor where the original does.

description: Policy of the live core: a Blocking pump of an unpaced modal loop (no InputSource::pace) is must_deliver at every call, because the replay rules hand a modal dispatch to the first such call with the dispatch's cursor count and the core cannot tell at a loop's first call whether the loop reads the cursor between its pumps. A playing host therefore blocks in those pumps: idle passes do not happen in a live session (the title menu's hover drawing, showHoleStatsScreen's clock-driven page turns between inputs). Paced loops (pumpAndRedraw, the credits) and the frame body's pumps may decline.
path to resolution: Tell the core the loop: InputSource::batch has no caller argument; commands.cpp pump_messages has `where`, which a shared-file change could pass on (cursor-reading loops could then decline once per cursor read).

description: sg_run_boot over a recording with one paced-loop clock answer left out (negative control live.recorder mode 1 + 16 * 5 on modal_wait) does not return within 300 s, and SG_TICK_CALL_LIMIT does not stop it: the loop is in a modal pump loop of commands.cpp, which does not go through TkBase::call. Observed only; the loop was not located.
path to resolution: Run the replay under a debugger or with a pass counter in pump_and_redraw; a malformed trace should end the run, not hang it.

description: The recorder writes a command's deadline clock (Command::t of onPoint / onUnpoint / onKey) at a synthetic site inside the root-handler range (frame_ra + 0x55951 + 0x40). No such read follows a HANDLER 2 / 3 / 7 record in sandbox_basic, ui_tour, cov_a_keys or cov_b_build, so the original's site was not observed; parse_trace keys the read by range only, and the recorder writes none when t is 0.
path to resolution: Find a corpus trace with g_audio5aa774 set (the deadline word) and take the site from it.

description: S1's working-tree changes (not in HEAD c6d7d78b): PumpKind::Load (loadFlic's pump takes the dispatch a trace puts before a world load's first palette QPC) and RootHandler commands 12 / 13 (keys a focus child took, from MSG records with no HANDLER) are not handled by the live core: Core::batch returns false for a modal non-Blocking call without asking the host, and the recorder writes no MSG records. After S1 merges, the trace host's equivalence on cov_r_flic_input and cov_r_bio needs both.
path to resolution: 1_merge.md section 4: forward Load calls to the host, write a palette QPC right after a Load dispatch, write 12 / 13 as MSG 0x100 / 0x102.

description: A live session that stops inside a frame (the host's Stop at a pump) leaves that frame's records partial; the replay's end-checkpoint step (tick_run_frames, final POLL not at a frame head) runs that last frame on until its frame wait or a Blocking pump with no input, which can take a path the live run never ran (no frame record is affected; the three scripted sessions stop at a frame head). A session that stops at a frame head ends its recording at the last FRAME record (the replay does not run a partial frame).
path to resolution: Hosts stop at a frame head (S7.3); or the recorder cuts a mid-frame stop back to the last FRAME record.

description: cov_b_location (boot with no frame head): the trace host's TraceInput tail-idle rule reads FrameIo::cursor, which a live frame leaves null, so a live run makes no idle pass past the last dispatch where sg_run_boot makes one per unread CURSOR record. No record is compared (NO_FRAMES), but phase 5's gfx snapshots of that scenario would differ between the two paths.
path to resolution: Give TraceHost its own tail-idle rule over its frame's cursor list when a gfx gate needs the live path.
